This is great news.

I was speaking to a representative from your company on the weekend and
someone was supposed to get back to me about my newest 2 units not working
at all?  Can I get an update on that by chance?

Thank you!
Take care,
Travis J. Gowland
Handed to the team · The follow-up we promised for Monday on his dead-unit case is overdue. The tech

Hi Travis,

Thanks for checking in. You're right: you were told someone would get back to you on Monday about the two dead units, and that didn't happen. Sorry about that.

I've just put your case back in front of the team. That includes the photos you sent on the weekend, the fact that your fuse is fine, and the question of which order the units came on. Someone will pick up your ticket and reply to you in this thread, usually within one business day. You don't need to send anything again.

While you wait, you can also get quick help on our Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf. Tag @nullhashrate, who is JD, our hardware lead.

Take care,
Hal, HeliumDeploy Technical Support
